messages:
elaine-cs: Kicking off Cascade's dedicated bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale curve, and a tight rollback plan — renewal team wants clean evidence.

sam-ops: Current committed = 900 qps. Proposal: autoscale min=100, target=450, max=900, step=100, cool_down=30s. Keeps gradual scale for chat patterns.

mike-eng: For load test: suggest 30m steady at 450 qps then progressive bursts: 700 for 3m, 900 for 3m. Run Wed 04:00 UTC after a 6h shadow-replay warmup.

lina-ml: We'll enable prefix KV warming and serve quantized variant (gpt-small-q) on pool-C; expect ~10% sustained reduction after warm cache. Will add kv_cache_hit_rate to dashboard.

olivia-renewal: Cascade flagged for renewal risk — we need p95 < 250ms in steady phase and a clear incident narrative if anything hits.

mike-eng: Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >1% for 4m OR p95 > 500ms for 3m. On trigger: abort bursts and route to hosted fallback.

sam-ops: I'll add tenant-protect throttle and temporary ingress cap for test window. Also will pre-authorize fallback with oncall.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q -> pool-C at 1759012675 :white_check_mark:

elaine-cs: Please paste the test commands and a short runbook snippet I can share with Cascade's SRE. Avoid sharing keys.

mike-eng: k6 commands: 
```
k6 run --vus 450 --duration 30m steady.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.cascade.redwood/v1/chat
k6 run --vus 700 --duration 3m burst1.js
k6 run --vus 900 --duration 3m burst2.js
```

sam-ops: Runbook snippet: if (error_rate > 0.01 for 4m) { route: hosted-fallback; alert: #oncall } if (p95 > 500ms for 3m) { abort_test(); notify: cs@redwood }

lina-ml: I'll export dashboard panels: poolC_p95, errors, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_fallback_count, scaling_events.

olivia-renewal: Great — post-test report should include p50/p95/p99, error taxonomy, token-cost delta, and a one-paragraph customer-facing summary for the renewal deck.

mike-eng: Ack. We'll redact keys and share grafana links + logs to this thread after run.

elaine-cs: Action items: Mike run test Wed 04:00 UTC; Sam apply autoscale + guardrails; Lina prep dashboards; Olivia draft renewal summary after report. I'll confirm the window with Cascade ops.
